## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run, their results, and any untested behavior. Distinguish host tests, ELF inspection, QEMU results, and manual checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] Kernel build succeeds.
- [ ] Host tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No host dependencies are introduced into the kernel.
- [ ] Boot has no observed regression, or boot validation is explicitly marked as pending.
- [ ] The change is tested where applicable; validation limits are stated above.
